figurative_meaning_en: Awakening of inner insight or the opening of the eye of knowledge
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চক্ষুরুন্মীলন হল যখন সে জীবনের সত্যিকারের অর্থ উপলব্ধি করল।
example_sentences_in_english: His eyes were opened when he grasped the true meaning of life.
Spiritual practice leads to the awakening of inner vision.
note: Derived from Sanskrit roots, often used in literary and philosophical contexts in Bengali.
